user.title: Dynamic Energy Tariff Compare
user.description: Where should the dynamic prices come from?

menu_options.tibber: Tibber Germany by postcode (built in, recommended)

tibber.title: Tibber Germany
tibber.description: Prices are fetched from tibber.com for your postcode every 30 minutes (yesterday, today and tomorrow, per quarter hour).

data.provider_name: Provider name (optional, e.g. Tibber, Rabot Energy, Octopus)
data.energy_entity: Grid import energy sensor (e.g. EDL21 total active energy / OBIS 1.8.0)

data_description.provider_name: Only used for display (device and entry name). Entity IDs stay the same.
data_description.postcode: Tibber's public price calculator is queried for this postcode: 15-minute all-in prices incl. energy, taxes/levies, grid fee and VAT. No Tibber account needed.

tibber_fees.title: Tariff values
tibber_fees.description: Tibber price for postcode {postcode} right now: {price} ct/kWh ({components}). Tibber monthly fees: {monthly} € ({monthly_components}); this total is prefilled as the dynamic tariff's monthly fee. Enter your current fixed tariff.

data_description.provider_monthly_fee_eur: Monthly fee of the dynamic tariff (provider base fee; add grid base fee/metering here if it differs from your fixed tariff). The default is only an example.

sensor.title: Dynamic Energy Tariff Compare
sensor.description: Compare a dynamic electricity tariff (Tibber, Rabot Energy, Octopus, …) with your fixed tariff. The price sensor must deliver the FINAL all-in price per kWh (incl. grid fees, taxes, levies, VAT and provider markup). The defaults are examples only.

data.provider_name: Provider name (optional, e.g. Tibber, Rabot Energy, Octopus)
data.energy_entity: Grid import energy sensor (e.g. EDL21 total active energy / OBIS 1.8.0)
data.price_entity: Price sensor: final all-in price per kWh

data_description.provider_name: Only used for display (device and entry name). Entity IDs stay the same.
data_description.price_entity: Pick a sensor that already includes all surcharges, e.g. your provider's integration (Tibber, …) or EPEX Spot with surcharges configured. 15-min price lists in attributes are used when present, otherwise the current state. Units: €/kWh, ct/kWh, €/MWh.
data_description.price_unit: Auto-detect uses the sensor's unit; if it has none, the value decides (below 2 → €/kWh, 2–200 → ct/kWh, above 200 → €/MWh). Select the unit if auto-detection is wrong.
data_description.provider_monthly_fee_eur: Monthly fee of the dynamic tariff (provider base fee; add grid base fee/metering here if it differs from your fixed tariff). The default is only an example.

error.invalid_postcode: Unknown or invalid German postcode (5 digits).
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach tibber.com. Try again later.
error.no_prices: Tibber returned no prices for this postcode.
error.price_not_numeric: The price sensor's state "{state}" is not a number and it has no price list. Check the sensor, or select the price unit manually to save anyway.
error.unknown: Unexpected error, see the Home Assistant log.

abort.already_configured: This energy sensor is already configured.
